standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The construction of the category of motives, in which morphisms between motives are given by correspondences satisfying a projection condition

standard_prerequisites.name: Characterization of a Karoubian category through kernels of idempotents
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Homology, the definition of a Karoubian category through the existence of kernels of idempotent endomorphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement to exhibiting the kernel of the complementary projector.

core_obligations: Build the candidate (proof lines 892-897): for a motive given by a scheme with an idempotent correspondence, the projector on the motive is an idempotent correspondence on the scheme; the motive of the scheme with that idempotent as its projection condition is then a well defined motive, and the idempotent itself defines a morphism from it to the original motive because it factors through the original projection.

Show it is the kernel (proof lines 897-905): a morphism into the original motive killed by the complementary projector becomes equal to the idempotent composed with it and satisfies the projection condition of the candidate, hence factors through it; therefore the complementary projector has a kernel, which by the characterization means that the category is Karoubian.
proof_roadmap: Realize the projector as an idempotent correspondence and construct the candidate kernel.
Verify the morphism and the factorization property.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the category of motives is Karoubian, that is, idempotent endomorphisms have kernels (statement lines 888-890). The proof (proof lines 891-905) builds the kernel as the motive whose projection condition is the idempotent itself and verifies the universal property through the description of morphisms by correspondences. H2: a complete short argument in two steps.
